body:
Checkout asks for an email address and a phone number, and some customers wonder why. Both are needed for good reasons: your email is where your order confirmation, payment details and tracking arrive, and your phone number lets carriers and our team reach you when a delivery or a payment needs attention. This guide explains the reason for each, what we do and do not do with them, how they relate to our privacy policy, how to keep them accurate, how marketing is handled, what choices you have and what to do if you do not want to share a particular detail. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Email: confirmations and payment details
Your email address receives your order confirmation, which includes your order ID and your private link. It also receives payment details for methods like Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime and gift cards, proof upload links, your payment confirmation and your tracking number. Without a valid email, you would not receive these, and the order could stall. Email also gives you a written record that you can search later. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).

### Why we do not use a different channel only
Some customers ask whether we could use only a phone number. Email is the best place for long, detailed messages with links, and it works on every device. Phone and chat complement it. We keep email as the main channel because it provides a reliable record for both of us.

## Phone: delivery and urgent issues
Carriers sometimes need to reach the recipient to arrange an adult-signature delivery, because the driver cannot leave the parcel. We may also call about payment mismatches, address questions or an order that needs a quick decision. If you choose WhatsApp, we use the same number for chat. Giving us a number that you answer, with the correct area code, avoids missed deliveries. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) and [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Why both?
Email and phone serve different needs. Email is for records and instructions. Phone is for urgency. Having both means that if one fails, such as an email that lands in spam, we can reach you another way. That is especially useful with payments, where time matters, and with deliveries, where a missed call can lead to a returned parcel.

## What we do with your information
We use it to fulfill your order, process payments, provide support and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us run the store, such as hosting, order storage, email and carriers, and only as needed. The full details are in our [privacy policy](/privacy/) and, for California residents, the [California privacy notice](/california-privacy/). If live chat is enabled, messages you type there are handled by the chat provider under its own policy.

## Your email and phone are not shown publicly
Your details are not published on the site, and the private order page is available only to people who have its link. Staff who handle your order can see them, and only for the purposes above. Carriers see your name, address and phone number, because they need them to deliver.

## Keeping it accurate
Typos cause missed emails and missed calls. Double-check your email address and your phone number before you submit. Use an address you check often, and add our address to your contacts. If something went wrong, see [what to do if the confirmation email does not arrive](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/). If you change your number or email while an order is open, tell us, quoting your order ID.

## Marketing
We do not use your order information for marketing without your consent. Messages we send about your order are service messages, such as confirmations and tracking, and are not marketing. If we ever offer news or offers, you will be asked, and you will be able to opt out.

## Your choices
You can ask us to update or delete your information, subject to legal requirements. Use the [contact page](/contact/) and write from the address on your order. We may need to keep some records for tax, accounting and legal reasons, as explained in the privacy policy. California residents have additional rights described in the [California privacy notice](/california-privacy/).

## What if I do not want to share a phone number?
A phone number is required for checkout because of the delivery and payment reasons above. If you have a concern, contact us before you order, and we will tell you what is possible. Some customers use a number that they answer rather than a personal mobile, such as a work line, where that suits them.

## What we never ask for
We never ask for your passwords, card numbers, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases by email or phone. If a message claiming to be from us asks for them, do not respond, and tell us. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Will you call me without warning?
We call only about your order, such as a delivery or a payment question. We will not call to sell you something. If you prefer messages, tell us, and we will use WhatsApp or email where we can.

### Can I use a work email or phone?
Yes, if you check it regularly and it accepts messages from us. Work filters can block commercial email, so a personal address is often more reliable.

### Do you share my number with the carrier?
Yes, because the carrier may need to contact you to arrange delivery. It is shared for that purpose only.

### How long do you keep my details?
For as long as needed for your order, returns, tax, accounting and legal requirements, after which we delete or anonymize them. See the [privacy policy](/privacy/).

### What if I used someone else's email by mistake?
Contact us with your order ID. We will confirm your identity and update the order.

## What each piece of information is used for, in one table of sentences
Your name appears on the order, the invoice and the shipping label so the carrier knows who the parcel is for. Your address is used for delivery and to check that we can lawfully ship to that place. Your email receives confirmations, payment details, proof links and tracking. Your phone number is used by the carrier and by us for delivery and urgent order questions. Your order details, such as items and totals, are used to fulfil the order and to answer questions about it. Your payment proof, such as a screenshot, is used only to confirm your payment. Nothing is collected without a purpose, and each item is described in the privacy policy.

## Good practice for protecting your own information
Use a strong, unique password for your email account, because email is where your order links and tracking arrive. Be wary of messages that imitate us and ask for sensitive information. Do not share your private order link. Keep your devices up to date and avoid entering personal details on networks you do not trust. These habits protect you with every online shop, not just ours.

## What happens to your data over time
After your order is complete, the records are kept for as long as needed for returns, tax, accounting and legal obligations. After that, they are deleted or anonymized. If you ask us to delete your information, we do so unless the law requires us to keep it, and we tell you what we have kept and why. You can ask at any time through the [contact page](/contact/).

## Special situations
### If you share a device or email
If someone else can see your email or phone, they can see our messages. Use an address and number that you control, and tell us if privacy is a concern, so we can send only what is needed.

### If you travel
If you are away from your usual email or phone, keep access to them through your phone or another device, so that you do not miss a delivery call or a payment message.

### If you have two numbers
Give the one you answer most. If you want us to use WhatsApp, give the number linked to your WhatsApp account.

## Frequently asked questions about contact details
### Can I change my email after I order?
Yes. Contact us from the address on the order, or give us the details of the order, and we will confirm your identity and update it. Do this before payment details are sent if you can.

### Why does the carrier call instead of leaving a note?
Because an adult must sign, the driver may call to arrange a time. Answering helps the delivery succeed on the first attempt.

### Do you ever contact me after the order is delivered?
Only if there is a reason connected with the order, such as a return, a question about a problem you reported or a reply to your message.
